test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements regarding line spacing of a paragraph in MS-Word 2010:

P: Line spacing determines the amount of vertical space between lines of text in a paragraph.

Q: Line spacing determines the amount of diagonal space between lines of text in a paragraph

Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?
solution:
The correct option is (1)

__Concept:-__

Line spacing in MS-Word 2010 determines the amount of vertical space between lines of text in a paragraph. It is the distance between the baselines of consecutive lines of text. It can be adjusted using the Line Spacing options in the Paragraph group on the Home tab of the ribbon.

Option Q is incorrect as diagonal spacing between lines of text is not a valid concept in MS-Word.

In general, there are four different line spacing options for words: single, 1.5 times, double, or a custom amount, where the numbers indicate the size of the space in relation to the width of a line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We have the flexibility to change the distance between two lines of text thanks to the line spacing option in MS Word or any other word processing program. 
 
• In Word, the standard line spacing is 1.15. By default, headings have a space above them, and paragraphs are followed by a blank line. 
 
• On the Home Tab, click the Line spacing command. From the menu, choose Remove Space Following a Paragraph or Add Space Before a Paragraph.
